test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter - cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter - cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter - cluster.

GIST : FEHGRQSR :: DUCK : CBTSBAJI :: LOPE : ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : 

 
• 2 letters code is assigned to each letter
 
• 1st letter code → (1) is subtracted from the position value according to English alphabetic series.
 
• 2nd letter code → (2) is subtracted from the position value according to English alphabetic series.

So,

 
• GIST : FEHGRQSR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7a58e376082438863933e99616b86ce88f9c57efca15957c10f9a38c40b97f0.png] 

And,

 
• DUCK : CBTSBAJI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e37e24bdb25e543b854549f4b052ef9f014709871cb39e50e5abc823f4025ced.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• LOPE : ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1e2bf8680363b2b3c641740af84253d761e67ec7fd4ae1ae0a92b39c21fbb38a.png] 

​Hence, "**KJNMONDC**" is the correct answer.

49
